source.label: 产品负责人访谈

content.zh-CN: 当无人机开始攻击工厂和资源中心，安防的假设失效了。
content.en-US: When drones began striking factories and resource sites, the assumptions behind site security stopped holding.

Low-altitude threats

source.label: 产品负责人访谈

content.zh-CN: 团队的判断来自两条同时发生的现实：低空攻击已经从战场扩散到民用资产，而现有反无设备仍然依赖人工值班和无线电对抗。翎翼科技与深圳技术大学共建低空具身智能系统协同创新实验室，把这个判断变成一套可自动值守的系统工程。
content.en-US: The team's thesis rests on two realities occurring at once: low-altitude attacks have spread from the battlefield to civilian assets, while existing counter-drone equipment still depends on human watch shifts and radio-frequency countermeasures. LinkEE and Shenzhen Technology University established a joint laboratory for low-altitude embodied intelligence systems to turn that thesis into a system engineering programme.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
团队希望让海外中资资产具备自动值守能力。
研发方向：云瞳感知与云台协同。
stageCopy.en-US:
Our goal: unattended protection for Chinese-invested sites overseas.
R&D direction: Yuntong sensing and turret coordination.

content.zh-CN: 塔方通报：2025 年 11 月 26 日，一处企业营地遭枪械及携带手榴弹的无人机袭击，3 名中国籍雇员死亡；11 月 30 日，另一场针对道路施工企业的武装袭击造成 2 名中国公民死亡。第二起通报未称使用无人机；两起事件也不是本项目的客户或防护效果证据。
content.en-US: Tajik authorities reported that an employees' camp was attacked with firearms and a grenade-carrying drone on 26 November 2025, killing three Chinese nationals. A separate armed attack on a road-construction company on 30 November killed two more. The second statement did not report drone use; neither incident is evidence of this project's customers or protective performance.

content.zh-CN: 03 / 问题
content.en-US: 03 / Problem

source.label: 产品负责人访谈

content.zh-CN: 一类新兴威胁不依赖无线电控制链路；单靠射频反制已经不够。
content.en-US: Some emerging threats do not rely on radio control links; RF countermeasures alone are insufficient.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
部分目标不用射频遥控
链路干扰有边界
stageCopy.en-US:
Beyond radio control
Limits of link jamming

source.label: 产品负责人访谈

zh-CN: 干扰器与电磁围栏：只针对无线电控制链路的设备无法切断光纤目标的控制与视频链路
人工蹲守：无法连续值守，远距离判断依赖个人经验
反制网：单次拦截，难以应对多轮多批次
共同缺口：识别、决策、执行没有闭环，响应时间取决于人
en-US: Jammers and electromagnetic fences: equipment that only disrupts radio control cannot sever a fibre-controlled target's command and video link
Human watch shifts: cannot sustain continuous coverage; long-range judgement depends on individual experience
Capture nets: single-engagement, poorly suited to repeated waves
Shared gap: detection, decision, and engagement are not closed-loop, so response time depends on a person

zh-CN: 光纤控制：链路干扰无法切断实体线缆
持续值守：希望减少人工判断与接力
系统协同：识别、坐标与执行仍需验证
en-US: Fibre control: link jamming cannot sever a physical cable
Continuous watch: the goal is less manual judgement and handoff
System coordination: detection, coordinates and execution still need validation

source.label: NATO Allied Command Transformation — 16th Innovation Challenge

content.zh-CN: 光纤 FPV 通过实体线缆传输操控和视频，依赖干扰无线电控制链路的传统反制手段难以奏效。北约因此把雷达、热成像、声学和光学列为候选探测路线；不能把“难以射频干扰”说成“所有传感器都看不见”。
content.en-US: Fibre-optic FPV drones carry command and video over a physical cable, limiting countermeasures that depend on disrupting radio control. NATO therefore identifies radar, thermal, acoustic, and optical sensors as candidate detection paths; resistance to RF jamming does not mean invisibility to every sensor.

stageCopy.zh-CN: 光纤抗链路干扰，不等于所有传感器都看不见。
stageCopy.en-US: Resistance to radio-link jamming does not mean invisibility to every sensor.

source.label: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine — War & Sanctions Lancet / Scalpel disclosure

content.zh-CN: 乌克兰国防情报部门在 2026 年 3 月披露：其分析的 Lancet 与 Scalpel 仍由操作员实时引导，Lancet 正尝试加入基于 NVIDIA Jetson 的自主制导元素；该部门此前也在一架 Shahed-136 MS 样本中识别过类似模块。这些特定样本不能证明无人机普遍自主，更不能证明本系统已经能够发现或拦截它们。
content.en-US: In March 2026, Ukraine's Defence Intelligence reported that the Lancet and Scalpel it examined were still guided by operators in real time, while autonomy elements using NVIDIA Jetson were being attempted for Lancet. The agency had also identified a similar module in a Shahed-136 MS specimen. These specific cases do not establish fleet-wide autonomy or this system's ability to detect or intercept such drones.

content.en-US: Yuntong detects the target and solves its position; the launch turret receives those coordinates to point and release.

source.label: 产品负责人系统关系确认

content.zh-CN: 这不是两个独立产品：云瞳是系统的感知与坐标入口，云台是执行终端。外围视觉数据经检测与坐标解算后，以统一坐标包下发给发射云台；云台再完成指向和拦截器释放。
content.en-US: These are not separate products. Yuntong is the system's sensing and coordinate input, while the turret is the execution endpoint. Perimeter vision is detected and solved into a common coordinate packet, dispatched to the launch turret, and then used for pointing and interceptor release.

实物闭环效果仍需联动测试验证。

Proposed design: shared target coordinates.
Integrated performance still requires physical testing.

source.label: 产品负责人访谈

content.zh-CN: 系统设计不以目标的无线电控制链路作为必要输入，但这不证明它已能发现或拦截光纤、自主飞行目标。对集群饱和攻击与高速俯冲目标的拦截边界也尚未实测，均属于全系统联动测试的验证项。
content.en-US: The system design does not require a target radio-control link as an input. That does not establish its ability to detect or intercept fibre-controlled or autonomous targets. Interception limits against saturation swarms and high-speed diving targets are also unmeasured and remain integrated-system test items.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
设计不依赖无线电遥控链路。
光纤、自主、饱和与高速俯冲目标的效果仍待实测。
stageCopy.en-US:
The design does not require a radio-control link.
Fibre, autonomous, swarm and diving-target performance is unmeasured.

source.label: docs/competitor-evidence.md — 产品定位假设与证据边界

content.zh-CN: 待验证的产品定位是把云瞳感知、目标坐标与云台执行作为一套系统交付，聚焦中资海外资产场景。本项目在采购价值、授权方式与性能上的差异尚未得到客户、法务和全系统测试证实。
content.en-US: The proposed positioning is to deliver Yuntong sensing, target coordinates, and turret execution as one system for Chinese-invested overseas assets. This project's advantages in purchasing value, release authority, and performance still require customer, legal, and integrated-system evidence.

source.label: 产品负责人访谈

zh-CN: 技术拐点：视觉解算精度提升与端侧算力成本下降使实时坐标解算可工程化
威胁拐点：无线电对抗失效的目标形态已有公开战场记录
供应链拐点：飞控、动力、光电与算力模块在国内可获得且成本可控
en-US: Technical inflection: improved vision-based solving accuracy and falling edge-compute cost make real-time coordinate solving engineerable
Threat inflection: target profiles that defeat radio-frequency countermeasures are now documented in open battlefield reporting
Supply chain inflection: flight control, propulsion, electro-optics, and compute modules are domestically available at controllable cost

zh-CN: 视觉与端侧算力：支持坐标解算的工程探索
国内供应链：飞控、动力、光电与算力模块可选
en-US: Vision and edge compute: enabling coordinate-solving R&D
Domestic supply: options for flight control, propulsion, optics and compute

question.zh-CN: 云瞳和发射云台是两个项目吗？
question.en-US: Are Yuntong and the launch turret separate projects?

source.label: 产品负责人系统关系确认

content.zh-CN: 不是。云瞳负责发现目标并形成方位坐标，坐标作为系统内部输入交给发射云台；云台负责指向与执行。当前动态页是离线模拟，不表示硬件联动已通过实测。
content.en-US: No. Yuntong detects the target and produces its position, which becomes an internal input to the launch turret; the turret is responsible for pointing and execution. The current dynamic page is an offline simulation, not proof that the hardware loop has passed measurement.

question.zh-CN: 这些 3D 数据是真实 CAD 还是演示模型？
question.en-US: Is this real CAD data or a presentation mockup?

source.label: 仓库 CAD 与爆炸回归测试

content.zh-CN: 当前项目源自 55.7 MB STEP，优化 GLB 保留 6 层装配图；节点、实例、爆炸和模型尺寸均有自动回归。当前为测试模型，装配层级与命名待标准化，替换后指标由测试重新生成。
content.en-US: The project comes from a 55.7 MB STEP file; the optimized GLB preserves a six-level assembly graph, with automated regressions for nodes, instances, explode layouts, and dimensions. This is a test model whose hierarchy and naming await standardisation; figures will be regenerated by tests after replacement.

question.zh-CN: 正式演示是否依赖网络或现场 AI？
question.en-US: Does the live presentation depend on network access or live AI?

source.label: 仓库架构、构建与离线查看器测试

content.zh-CN: 不依赖。正式内容、模型和批准后的 AI 图片均由本地服务提供；AI 只在演示前的资产生产阶段使用。
content.en-US: No. Formal content, models, and approved AI imagery are served locally; AI is used only during pre-presentation asset production.

question.zh-CN: 双摄像机软件目前真实完成了什么？
question.en-US: What has the dual-camera software actually completed?

source.label: Yuntong_Project commit f32b055（代码、19 项桌面端测试与构建）

content.zh-CN: 固定提交包含 Electron/React 工作台与 Python Sidecar，可读取两路 RTSP，执行 TensorRT person 检测、每路独立跟踪、带框录像和抓拍，并通过 loopback 与短期 Bearer token 隔离本地服务。当前公开模型只检测完整人体，不做人脸、身份或性别判断，也不包含无人机识别和反制；它证明的是本地视频推理工作台的工程实现，不替代系统级探测与拦截实测。
content.en-US: The pinned commit contains an Electron/React workbench and Python sidecar for two RTSP streams, TensorRT person detection, independent per-stream tracking, annotated recording and snapshots, with the local service isolated by loopback and a short-lived bearer token. The public model detects full persons only: it performs no face, identity, or gender inference and contains no drone recognition or countermeasure capability. It evidences a local video-inference workbench, not system-level detection or interception performance.

question.zh-CN: 为什么不用干扰，而选择动能拦截？
question.en-US: Why kinetic interception rather than jamming?

source.label: docs/threat-evidence.md — NATO technical boundary and D-039 product design

content.zh-CN: 不能把“干扰”一概排除。只靠切断无线电遥控或视频链路的手段，无法切断光纤目标承载这些信息的实体线缆；但这不等于所有电子或非动能手段都无效。当前提出云瞳感知、云台指向并释放拦截器，是待验证的系统方案，不是“只有动能有效”的事实结论。选择依据还需要比较目标覆盖、误伤风险、授权条件与全系统实测。
content.en-US: Jamming should not be dismissed wholesale. A measure that only severs a radio-control or video link cannot sever the physical cable carrying those signals on a fibre-controlled drone; that does not make every electronic or non-kinetic measure ineffective. Yuntong sensing, turret pointing, and interceptor release are a proposed system design, not proof that only kinetic methods work. The choice still requires evidence on target coverage, collateral risk, authorization, and integrated-system tests.

question.zh-CN: 已有 Fortem 和 Anduril，你们的差异化是什么？
question.en-US: Fortem and Anduril already exist. What is your differentiation?

source.label: Fortem Technologies — SkyDome Manager 产品说明，2026-09-24 查阅

content.zh-CN: Fortem 官方产品说明显示，SkyDome 已整合传感器、指挥控制和 DroneHunter，并支持人工授权或自动响应。因此“我们自动、他们人工”以及“只有我们交付整套系统”都不成立。
content.en-US: Fortem's own product documentation describes SkyDome as integrating sensors, command and control, and DroneHunter, with either human authorization or automated response. Accordingly, neither autonomy nor delivery of an integrated system is a unique claim for this project.

source.label: U.S. Marine Corps Portfolio Acquisition Executive — Anvil 演示报道，2026-09-24 查阅

content.zh-CN: 美国海军陆战队项目办公室说明，Anduril Anvil 可自主跟踪，在其报道的 I-CsUAS 配置中由操作员下令拦截；2026 年 3 月完成动能拦截演示。该报道不能推导 Anvil 在所有部署中都采用同一授权策略，也不能把演示写成全面列装。
content.en-US: The U.S. Marine Corps programme office says Anduril Anvil autonomously tracks and, in the I-CsUAS configuration it describes, intercepts on operator command; a kinetic intercept was demonstrated in March 2026. This account does not establish the authorization policy of every deployment or prove full fielding of the Anvil enhancement.

source.label: docs/competitor-evidence.md — 竞品事实审查与定位假设（待产品负责人确认）

content.zh-CN: 我们目前只能提出待验证的定位：面向中资海外资产，把云瞳感知、坐标传递与云台执行组织为一套交付。是否在目标客户的采购约束、总成本、授权流程或效果上形成可持续优势，尚无同口径证据；需要客户访谈、全系统联动测试和目标法域法律意见后才能定稿。
content.en-US: Our current positioning remains a hypothesis: deliver Yuntong sensing, coordinate transfer, and turret execution as one system for Chinese-invested overseas assets. There is no like-for-like evidence yet of a durable advantage in purchasing constraints, total cost, release authorization, or outcomes. Customer interviews, integrated-system tests, and legal opinions in the target jurisdictions are needed before making a definitive differentiation claim.

question.zh-CN: 系统的探测距离、延迟和拦截成功率是多少？
question.en-US: What are the system's detection range, latency, and interception success rate?

content.zh-CN: [待实测] 当前没有可对外发布的系统级探测、延迟、跟踪或拦截指标；完成测量方法、原始遥测与复测前不提供性能数字。
content.en-US: [Measurement required] No system-level detection, latency, tracking, or interception metric is currently approved for publication; no performance figure will be offered before the method, raw telemetry, and repeat test are available.

question.zh-CN: 出口与部署的合法性如何解决？
question.en-US: How are export and deployment legality addressed?

source.label: 初步检索线索：SCMP; MOFCOM announcement（待律师核对）

content.zh-CN: [待律师意见] 动能拦截系统的中国出口管制归类、目标法域部署授权及私营主体处置权限均未确认；取得中国出口管制律师与目标国当地律师的书面意见前不陈述法律结论。
content.en-US: [Counsel opinion required] Chinese export-control classification, deployment authority in each target jurisdiction, and private-operator mitigation powers are unconfirmed; no legal conclusion will be stated before written opinions from Chinese export-control and local counsel.

question.zh-CN: 当前客户与商业进展是什么？
question.en-US: What customer and commercial traction exists today?

content.zh-CN: [待确认公开口径] 当前没有可公开、可验证的客户证据；不展示任何不具名或不可公开的意向。
content.en-US: [Public wording required] No public, verifiable customer evidence is currently approved; unnamed or non-disclosable interest is not shown.

question.en-US: How will this round be used?

content.zh-CN: [待创始人确认] 金额、对外出让范围、资金用途与量化里程碑尚未定稿；正式回答不得包含内部谈判底线。
content.en-US: [Founder approval required] Round size, public equity range, use of funds, and measurable milestones are not final; the formal answer must never include internal negotiation limits.

note.zh-CN: 融资、团队配置、性能目标和试点计划为展示示例；CAD 数字与引用新闻保留真实来源。示例不代表实测、订单或正式承诺。
note.en-US: Funding, staffing, performance targets and pilot plans are illustrative. CAD figures and cited news retain their real sources. Examples are not measured results, orders or commitments.

productName.zh-CN: 云瞳感知 × 发射云台

content.zh-CN:
很多人在造更锋利的矛
我们只造最坚固的盾
content.en-US:
Many are building sharper spears.
We build only the strongest shield.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
云瞳
低空安防系统
stageCopy.en-US:
Yuntong
Airspace Security

content.zh-CN:
面向海外中资资产，打造自动值守的低空防御系统。
设计目标：不依赖对方是否使用无线电遥控。
content.en-US:
Building unattended airspace defence for Chinese-invested sites overseas.
Design goal: protection independent of radio remote control.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
视频感知 / RID 信息 / 坐标协同
设计目标：不以无线电遥控为前提。
stageCopy.en-US:
Video sensing / RID information / coordinate handoff
Design goal: independent of radio remote control.

content.zh-CN:
无人机威胁逼近民用资产
我们开始低空防御研发
content.en-US:
Drone threats reach civilian sites.
We begin airspace defence R&D.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
低空威胁逼近资产
我们开始防御研发
stageCopy.en-US:
Low-altitude threats
Our R&D response

content.zh-CN: 我们从工业园、资源营地与能源设施的值守需求出发，把云瞳感知、方位坐标与发射云台组织为一个系统。产品方向是降低人工接力成本，让风险发现、判断与响应更连贯。
content.en-US: We start with watchkeeping needs at industrial parks, resource camps and energy sites, bringing Yuntong sensing, coordinates and the launch turret into one system. The product direction is less manual handoff and a clearer detection-to-response workflow.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
从工业园、资源营地与能源设施出发。
把感知、判断与响应连成一条链。
stageCopy.en-US:
Start with industrial parks, resource camps and energy sites.
Connect sensing, judgement and response.

content.zh-CN:
有些目标不靠无线电遥控
单靠链路干扰不够
content.en-US:
Some targets do not use radio control.
Link jamming alone is not enough.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
部分目标不用射频遥控
链路干扰有边界
stageCopy.en-US:
Beyond radio control
Limits of link jamming

zh-CN: 光纤控制：无线电链路干扰无法切断实体线缆
持续值守：用自动感知减少人工接力
系统协同：让坐标进入执行端，而不止于告警
en-US: Fibre control: radio-link jamming cannot sever a physical cable
Continuous watch: automatic sensing reduces manual handoffs
Coordination: send coordinates to the effector, not just an alarm

content.zh-CN:
云瞳负责感知与坐标
云台负责指向与释放
content.en-US:
Yuntong senses and locates.
The turret points and releases.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
云瞳感知与坐标
云台指向与释放
stageCopy.en-US:
Yuntong locates
The turret responds

content.zh-CN: 系统方案把视频感知、可用的 RID 广播、目标坐标和云台任务串联。操作员可选中飞机或广播提供的控制站点位，查看信息并进入处置流程。当前网页为离线交互模拟，不连接接收器或真实云台。
content.en-US: The concept connects video sensing, available RID broadcasts, coordinates and turret tasks. Operators can select an aircraft or a broadcast control-station location to inspect information and enter the response workflow. This page is an offline simulation, with no receiver or real turret connection.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
视频感知 + RID 信息 + 坐标协同。
单击目标，聚焦飞机或广播控制站位置。
stageCopy.en-US:
Video sensing + RID information + coordinate handoff.
Select a target to focus the aircraft or broadcast control station.

content.zh-CN: 设计不以对方使用无线电遥控为前提；针对光纤或自主飞行目标，走感知与物理响应路线。演示中的广播、机型、坐标和轨迹均为合成示例，不表示目标已经识别或拦截成功。
content.en-US: The design does not assume radio remote control; fibre-controlled or autonomous targets motivate sensing and physical-response paths. Broadcasts, model labels, coordinates and tracks in the demo are synthetic, not evidence of successful detection or interception.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
设计不依赖无线电遥控链路。
RID、机型与轨迹为模拟，不代表拦截结果。
stageCopy.en-US:
The design is independent of radio remote control.
RID, model labels and tracks are simulated, not intercept results.

content.zh-CN: 产品定位：面向中资海外资产，把云瞳感知与发射云台作为一套交付；以模块化部署、本地数据处理和可追溯任务记录组织产品体验。这里描述产品路线，不宣称比竞品更低价或更有效。
content.en-US: Positioning: one sensing-and-turret delivery for Chinese-invested overseas sites, with modular deployment, local processing and traceable task records. This describes the product direction, not a claim of lower cost or greater effectiveness than competitors.

content.zh-CN:
低空防御需求出现
工程条件逐步具备
content.en-US:
Airspace protection demand is emerging.
Engineering foundations are advancing.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
需求正在出现
工程条件逐步具备

zh-CN: 需求端：从重要设施与海外园区切入
技术端：视觉、端侧算力与坐标解算协同
交付端：模块化硬件与本地软件一体化
en-US: Demand: start with critical facilities and overseas sites
Technology: combine vision, edge compute and coordinates
Delivery: modular hardware with local software

content.zh-CN: 部署路线按目标地区的授权条件设计：先演示与封闭测试，再与当地具备资质的合作方评估试点。出口与处置权限由适用地区的专业意见确定；本页不作已获授权或可自由部署的法律结论。
content.en-US: Deployment is planned around jurisdiction-specific authority: demonstrations and controlled tests first, followed by pilot assessment with qualified local partners. Export and mitigation powers require local professional advice; this is not a statement of existing authorization or unrestricted deployment rights.

stageCopy.zh-CN: 部署路径：先封闭测试，再按当地授权推进试点。
stageCopy.en-US: Deployment path: controlled tests, then locally authorized pilots.

content.zh-CN:
反制发射云台
展开真实装配结构
content.en-US:
The interceptor launch turret.
Explore its real assembly structure.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
双机发射云台
感知与执行协同
stageCopy.en-US:
Dual-aircraft launch
Sensing + response

content.zh-CN: 逐层爆炸、部件聚焦和工程名浏览均对应当前 CAD 装配。404 个原始实体、427 个图节点和外包围尺寸来自仓库回归，不是虚构的演示数字，也不代表反制性能。
content.en-US: Hierarchical explode, part focus and engineering names correspond to the current CAD. The 404 source solids, 427 graph nodes and envelope come from repository regressions, not invented demo figures or countermeasure performance.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
双机布局、发射支架与集成底座。
CAD展示结构，不代表反制性能。
stageCopy.en-US:
Twin-aircraft layout, launch supports and integrated base.
CAD shows structure, not countermeasure performance.

content.zh-CN:
工程基础已经建立
下一步验证系统闭环
content.en-US:
Engineering foundations are in place.
Next: validate the integrated system.

content.zh-CN: 研发组织采用算法、机械、嵌入式与测试协作的方案。样例阶段由产品负责人统筹接口、场景与验收，成员信息和机构关系在后续正式材料中单独补充。
content.en-US: The R&D structure combines algorithms, mechanics, embedded systems and testing. In this example the product lead coordinates interfaces, scenarios and acceptance; individual credentials and institutional relationships are outside this demonstration.

note.zh-CN: 概念设计参数，不是本轮展示提供的遥测或试飞结论。
note.en-US: Concept design parameter, not telemetry or a flight-test result supplied by this demo.

content.zh-CN: 从当前 CAD、视频推理工作台和实物制作记录进入下一阶段：同步相机与云台时钟、验证坐标接口，再做封闭场景联调。样例时间表以融资到账为起点，不代表已经完成联动测试。
content.en-US: Current CAD, the video-inference workstation and reported hardware fabrication lead into camera/turret clock alignment, coordinate-interface checks and controlled integration tests. The example schedule starts at funding receipt and does not claim completed integration tests.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
现阶段：CAD、视频工作台与实物制作。
下一步：坐标接口与封闭场景联调。
stageCopy.en-US:
Now: CAD, video workstation and hardware fabrication.
Next: coordinate interfaces and controlled integration tests.

content.zh-CN: 展示目标参数：500 米探测距离、200 毫秒坐标更新延迟、8 个并行跟踪目标。均为样例设计目标，不是系统实测；后续实验按距离、视场、天气和目标类型分别记录结果。
content.en-US: Illustrative targets: 500 m detection range, 200 ms coordinate-update latency and eight simultaneous tracks. These are example design goals, not measured performance; later experiments will record distance, field of view, weather and target type.

stageCopy.zh-CN:
目标参数：500 米探测 · 200 毫秒坐标更新 · 8 目标跟踪。
为展示设计目标，非实测结果。
stageCopy.en-US:
Targets: 500 m sensing · 200 ms updates · 8 tracks.
Illustrative design goals, not measured results.

content.zh-CN: 商业样例计划：12 个月内评估 2 个授权示范场景，以 4 套样机完成部署、运维与可用性验证。先做场景评估与联合测试，再形成产品报价；这些数量不是现有客户、签约订单或营收。
content.en-US: Example commercial plan: assess two authorized demonstration sites and use four prototypes for deployment, maintenance and availability validation within 12 months. Site assessment and joint tests precede pricing; these counts are not existing customers, orders or revenue.

content.zh-CN: 技术积累路线：目标数据集、坐标标定工具、软硬件接口、结构迭代与测试记录。以可重复的数据和工程流程形成壁垒；本展示不列不存在的专利、申请号或权属证明。
content.en-US: Technical asset roadmap: target datasets, coordinate-calibration tools, interfaces, mechanical iterations and test records. Build capability through reproducible data and engineering workflows; this demo does not invent patents, filings or ownership records.

zh-CN: 1–3 月：目标数据集、坐标接口与台架联调
4–6 月：封闭测试、误报评估与系统复测
7–12 月：2 个示范场景、4 套样机与运维验证
en-US: Months 1–3: datasets, coordinate interface and bench integration
Months 4–6: controlled tests, false-alarm assessment and retests
Months 7–12: two demo sites, four prototypes and maintenance trials

十二个月走完验证链
从封闭测试到场景试点

content.zh-CN: 六人跨学科团队配置
content.en-US: A six-person cross-functional team plan

content.zh-CN:
算法 2 人 · 机械 1 人 · 嵌入式 1 人

content.en-US:
2 algorithms · 1 mechanical · 1 embedded
1 product · 1 business development

content.zh-CN:
种子轮 · 500 万元
十二个月完成系统验证
content.en-US:
Seed round · RMB 5 million.
12 months to validate.

zh-CN: 研发预算已包含团队薪酬，不重复列支
交付目标：2 个示范场景 + 4 套样机
资金 + 场景 + 行业资源，共同完成验证
en-US: 55% R&D · 25% testing · 15% delivery · 5% operations
Team salaries are included in R&D, with no double-counting
Deliverable target: two demo sites + four prototypes
Capital, sites and sector partnerships for validation

content.zh-CN: 本页是融资叙事示例：500 万元分别用于研发 275 万、测试 125 万、交付 75 万、运营 25 万。研发包含团队薪酬；测试覆盖外场、仪器和验证费用，交付覆盖样机物料与部署。未设估值、股权比例或谈判底线，不构成融资要约。
content.en-US: Example funding narrative: RMB 5 million allocated as 2.75 million to R&D, 1.25 million to testing, 0.75 million to delivery and 0.25 million to operations. R&D includes salaries, testing covers trials and equipment, and delivery covers prototype materials and installation. No valuation, equity share or negotiating floor is specified; this is not a funding offer.

content.zh-CN: 是一个项目。云瞳是感知与坐标入口，发射云台是执行端；RID 提供可用的广播信息作为辅助线索。当前校园页面演示从目标选择到飞机或控制站聚焦的交互，不连接真实硬件。
content.en-US: They form one project. Yuntong is the sensing-and-coordinate entry point, and the launch turret is the effector. Available RID broadcasts provide auxiliary information. The campus page demonstrates target selection and aircraft/control-station focus without real hardware.

content.zh-CN: 我们选择补齐“感知—坐标—执行”链，而不是只做无线电链路干扰。光纤目标的实体线缆不能靠无线电链路干扰切断，但电子与非动能手段仍有各自适用条件。产品方案保留多传感器和处置方式的协同空间，当前演示不宣称只有动能有效。
content.en-US: The direction is to complete the sensing–coordinates–execution chain rather than rely only on radio-link jamming. Radio-link interference cannot sever a fibre cable, but electronic and non-kinetic methods still have their own applications. The concept leaves room for multiple sensors and response methods; it does not claim only kinetic defeat works.

content.zh-CN: 我们聚焦海外中资资产的部署场景，以本地数据处理、感知与云台的一体化交付、可追溯运维记录组织产品。竞品已经有自主能力和完整系统，差异化要落在具体场景适配与交付体验，不能声称只有我们自动化。
content.en-US: Our positioning focuses on Chinese-invested overseas sites, local processing, sensing-plus-turret delivery and traceable maintenance. Competitors already have autonomous capability and integrated systems; differentiation must come from site fit and delivery experience, not a claim of unique automation.

content.zh-CN: 本稿采用三个样例设计目标：500 米探测、200 毫秒坐标更新、8 个并行目标。数字用于讲清楚系统预期，不是实测。拦截成功率不编造百分比；闭环测试将记录原始视频、时戳和遥测，再形成正式性能表。
content.en-US: The example targets are 500 m detection, 200 ms coordinate updates and eight simultaneous targets. They explain intended capability, not measured performance. No intercept success rate is invented; integration trials will retain video, timestamps and telemetry before a formal performance table is issued.

content.zh-CN: 路线是先做演示与封闭测试，再按目标地区的出口、运营与处置授权条件推进试点，并与有资质的当地合作方协作。本稿不声称已拿到许可，也不把获得许可作为已经完成的进展。
content.en-US: The route begins with demonstrations and controlled tests, followed by pilots under applicable export, operation and mitigation authority with qualified local partners. This draft does not claim permits have been obtained or count approval as completed progress.

content.zh-CN: 展示版商业计划以工业园、能源设施与资源营地为切入场景：12 个月评估 2 个示范点、配置 4 套样机，再形成项目交付与运维服务方案。这是计划样例，不是客户名单、已签订单或营收数据。
content.en-US: The illustrative commercial plan starts with industrial parks, energy facilities and resource camps: two demonstration sites and four prototypes over 12 months, followed by delivery and maintenance offerings. This is a plan, not a customer list, signed orders or revenue.

content.zh-CN: 样例种子轮 500 万元，支持 12 个月研发验证。275 万研发、125 万测试、75 万交付、25 万运营，合计 500 万；团队薪酬计入研发一次。目标是完成闭环验证、2 个示范场景和 4 套样机，不涉及股权比例或内部谈判信息。
content.en-US: The illustrative RMB 5 million seed round supports 12 months of validation: 2.75 million R&D, 1.25 million testing, 0.75 million delivery and 0.25 million operations. Salaries are counted once in R&D. Targets are integrated validation, two demonstration sites and four prototypes; equity terms and internal negotiations are not included.
